intro: One tosai masala is roughly 350 kcal. Most of the calories come from the rice tosai and the potato masala filling cooked with oil.

breakdown.part: Oil or ghee on the griddle

diet: Yes, this is one of the lighter options at the mamak. Tosai is made from fermented rice and dal, so it uses less oil than roti canai. Protein is a bit low though. Add an egg or dal so you stay full longer.
tips: Add a half-boiled egg or order tosai telur for more protein.
Take more sambar and less coconut chutney.
Ask for no ghee if you want to save calories.

swap.name: 3 idli with sambar
swap.why: Idli is steamed without oil, so it's lighter but still filling with sambar.

faq.a: A batter of rice and urad dal that's soaked, ground and fermented overnight. That's why it tastes slightly sour.

faq.q: What's the difference between tosai and tosai masala?
faq.a: Tosai masala has a potato filling with onion, turmeric and spices. Plain tosai is eaten on its own with chutney and sambar.
Sambar is a dal gravy with vegetables like carrot, brinjal and long beans. It adds some protein and fibre to the meal.
